rules.rule: Every v2.2.0-enforced control (C-REG, C-CUR, C-NOAUDIT, C-HIST, C-B1M, C-B1B, C-OPTC, C-WIN, Q0 calibration of the checkers) stays mandatory at the final RC. Retiring, rebinding or relaxing any of them needs an explicit committed owner decision.

No inventory is promoted: no superseded row, empty-phase record, record outside mutation.RECORDS, worker log, historical campaign or unbound field (kill-set names, kill-file content, closure, platform, ruling authenticity beyond is_file) is v2.3 evidence.

Every target whose module any v2.3 lane owns for edit (DAG §4, W1-DESIGN §8, globs expanded at v2.2.0), or whose LF digest at the final RC differs from v2.2.0, is CHANGED_TRUST_CRITICAL: measured at the final RC, never reused. The set is monotone; an unplanned change adds to it, and only an owner decision removes a planned module that ended untouched. The digest clause is evaluated mechanically over every target module at the final RC; a row whose module a design option may edit without lane ownership carries planned_change_possible.

New code is MEASURE_NEW, measured at the final RC: every design-declared target; every mutation._root with >= 1 site in a module created after v2.2.0 that OD-NEWMOD or OD-F5ENG brings into scope (an OD-NEWVAL module only if the owner extends scope); and the v2.3-added or changed authority roots of validation/v2/mutation.py (OD-F5ENG). An existing module that a lane edits and that has no v2.2.0 target is not a target by this rule: it has a row under OD-EDITNOTARGET with its v2.2.0 control and its cost if promoted. Roots not yet written are enumerated at their wave's design freeze.

A REUSE_CANDIDATE is reused only by a proven F5 VERIFIED_REUSE at the final RC, produced by the engine version the owner authorized (pinned by digest in the final-RC record), with its proof committed; otherwise it is measured. UNRESOLVED is never accepted.

Release evidence for each target is its final-RC measurement by the runner-2 classifier: genuine outcome, T0 PASS, NOT_RUN never PASS, every survivor audited at the measured digest in the append-only v2.3 audit file, except NO_AUDIT targets, which must be fully killed (C-NOAUDIT). posix targets on the host family SCALE-1 names; the 3 Windows-only targets natively (OD-WIN). Per-wave measurements (DAG §6, unless OD-WAVE replaces it) are wave-gate evidence and never enter the release claim.
Every owner decision defaults to the trust-keeping choice until the owner commits another one.

No 667-, 891-, 994-target or final-RC campaign runs without the owner's separate authorization (OD-RUN-FINAL). Until then the final-RC set is NOT_RUN and the release is blocked; nothing in this manifest is a measurement.
